create_Act_class: create an Act module instance with a named activation function like relu or swish
build_Act_forward: build a forward pass through the Act module using a torch tensor as input
test_Act_leaky_activations: test the Act class with leaky_relu, leaky_sp, or leaky_elu activation types
review_Act_supported_activations: review the Act class to see all 11 supported activation function types
refactor_Act_slope_parameter: refactor the Act class to use a custom slope value for leaky activation variants
